part_type: # The part-type overhangs, straight from the Yeast Toolkit paper:
#   Lee, DeLoache, Cervantes, Dueber (2015) ACS Synth. Biol. 4, 975-986
#   doi:10.1021/sb500366v  -  Supplementary Text, "Definition of Part Types"
# A part Type is defined ONLY by its flanking overhangs. What a part contains is
# a convention, not a rule, which is why the fourth column is a description and
# Every row was checked twice: against the paper, and against the 96 published
# plasmid maps in reference/ytk_plasmids/, by finding their BsaI sites. Both
# agree with every row. The overhangs chain into a circle:
#   CCCT -> AACG -> TATG -> ATCC -> GCTG -> TACA -> GAGT -> CCGA -> CCCT

contents: promoter; the TATG doubles as the start codon
coding sequence, N-terminal half of a fusion
coding sequence, C-terminal half of a fusion
yeast origin, or 3' homology arm for integration
bacterial origin and marker; NotI sites both sides
